e0c6fa9c33231c71.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة المشورة للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية عن حاجتها لاستقطاب محامين مرخصين للانضمام إلى فريقها القانوني. هذا الدور متاح في مدينتي الدمام والرياض، وهو مخصص للمحامين ذوي الخبرة الذين يمتلكون رخصة محاماة سارية المفعول في المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 3 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المحاماة. المهام والمسؤوليات إدارة القضايا القانونية المختلفة وتمثيل العملاء أمام المحاكم والجهات القضائية بمختلف درجاتها. إعداد ومراجعة اللوائح والمذكرات القانونية والاعتراضات بدقة واحترافية. صياغة ومراجعة العقود والاتفاقيات لضمان الامتثال القانوني وحماية مصالح العملاء. تقديم الاستشارات القانونية للعملاء بناءً على الأنظمة واللوائح المعمول بها. متابعة التحديثات المستمرة التي تطرأ على الأنظمة واللوائح القضائية في المملكة. المؤهلات والخبرات الحصول على رخصة محاماة سارية المفعول في المملكة العربية السعودية. خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في مجال المحاماة. خبرة سابقة في العمل لدى مكاتب أو شركات المحاماة. إلمام تام بالأنظمة واللوائح القضائية في المملكة العربية السعودية. المهارات المطلوبة قدرة عالية على إدارة القضايا القانونية بفعالية. مهارات متقدمة في البحث والصياغة القانونية. دقة عالية في تقديم الاستشارات القانونية. بيئة العمل سيعمل المحامي المرخص ضمن فريق قانوني متخصص في شركة المشورة للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتوفر بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم التطوير المستمر في مجال القانون. معلومات إضافية تُعد هذه الفرصة مناسبة للمحامين الذين يسعون لتطبيق خبراتهم في بيئة ديناميكية ومتطورة في مجال المحاماة والاستشارات القانونية في المملكة العربية السعودية.

e092b1fd6ff43136.description: About the Role Elm is seeking an Audit Governance & Integrity Principal to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to enhancing internal audit effectiveness and organizational integrity. The principal will provide expert guidance on audit strategy, methodology, quality assurance, and performance reporting, while also coordinating activities related to whistleblowing, fraud prevention, and investigation support. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development and execution of the Internal Audit Strategy and its implementation roadmap. Develop and update internal audit methodologies, procedures, and practical guidance, ensuring consistent application across audit teams. Implement and maintain the Internal Audit Quality Assurance Program, assessing adherence to approved methodologies and professional standards. Develop and maintain performance indicators for internal audit, integrity, and fraud prevention activities, preparing executive reports and dashboards. Coordinate the operation of whistleblowing channels, review and route reports, and track case status while ensuring confidentiality. Support fraud risk assessments, develop recommendations for preventive controls, and coordinate fraud prevention initiatives. Provide support for authorized investigations through evidence compilation, analysis, and documentation, and recommend preventive actions based on lessons learned. Develop and deliver awareness sessions and training materials on integrity, ethical conduct, and fraud prevention. Compliance and Security Adhere to all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Comply with all applicable safety, quality, environmental management, and information security policies and standards to ensure a secure and healthy work environment and data integrity. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in audit governance, integrity, or a related field. Demonstrated expertise in audit strategy, methodology, quality assurance, and performance reporting. Experience in coordinating whistleblowing, fraud prevention, and investigation support activities. Strong understanding of professional standards and ethical conduct in internal audit. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to strengthening audit practices and ethical conduct within Elm.

e0a969117b67798a.description: About the Role DP World Jeddah is seeking an experienced Supervisor Lashing to join its Operations team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading and managing all lashing and unlashing activities on vessels, under quay cranes, and in designated yard areas, ensuring adherence to safety standards and operational procedures. Role Purpose The Lashing Supervisor is responsible for the safe and efficient execution of lashing operations. This includes supervising lashing teams, coordinating activities with Vessel/Yard Supervisors, and monitoring performance to support vessel and yard productivity and turnaround targets. The role ensures compliance with all safety practices and operational procedures. Key Responsibilities Directly supervise lashers during vessel and special yard operations to ensure correct and timely execution of lashing and unlashing activities. Ensure compliance with approved lashing procedures and vessel operational sequences. Coordinate lashing activities with Vessel Supervisors and Quay Crane Operators to align with loading and discharge operations. Ensure adequate manpower allocation based on operational requirements and vessel priorities. Enforce HSSE requirements, PPE compliance, safe access, and working at height procedures. Ensure safe working practices in high-risk areas, including onboard vessels and under quay cranes. Verify the availability and proper condition of lashing gear, twist locks, and securing equipment. Inspect equipment and report defective, damaged, or missing items for replacement or corrective action. Monitor lashing team attendance, discipline, and operational performance. Ensure efficient manpower utilization and timely completion of assigned activities to support vessel productivity targets. Immediately report incidents, unsafe conditions, operational delays, and equipment issues to the Vessel Supervisor and relevant departments. Maintain accurate shift reports detailing operational progress, manpower utilization, equipment issues, and safety incidents. Ensure proper deployment and positioning of lashers to support vessel berthing and unberthing operations. Qualifications and Experience Experience in container terminal operations. Experience in lashing supervision. A minimum of 2 to 5 years of relevant experience is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the Operations team of DP World Jeddah. Application Candidates with experience in container terminal operations and lashing supervision are encouraged to apply.

e03bf2ad97ac48c7.description: About Misk Schools Misk Schools is seeking a dedicated Counsellor to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on providing essential mental health support to students, particularly those with additional needs, to foster their social and emotional development. Role Overview The Counsellor will deliver continuous mental health support, working within a multidisciplinary framework to address students' needs comprehensively. The role involves close collaboration with students, parents, academic staff, and external support agencies to ensure a supportive and safe environment for all students. Key Responsibilities Lead and support the assessment and treatment of students with mental health needs, liaising with students, parents, the academic team, and external agencies such as educational psychologists. Address student challenges including self-esteem, anger management, time management, academic coping strategies, friendship issues, communication skills, grieving, and depression. Provide regular counselling sessions to identified or referred students. Communicate closely with the Head Counsellor and Designated Safeguarding Lead regarding students of concern. Conduct specialist psychotherapeutic assessments and develop tailored programmes of care, offering individual or group psychotherapeutic treatment. Observe students and respond to their verbal and behavioural communications, creating a safe and belonging environment. Attend core group meetings and collaborate with other professionals in planning support for children and their families across various settings. Regularly review and monitor the outcomes of assessments and the effectiveness of treatment. Offer psychoanalytic and psychotherapeutic advice, training, consultation, and supervision to other professionals involved in a child's treatment plan. Liaise with the Assistant Principal’s Wellbeing to promote broader wellbeing initiatives, including student talks, staff INSET, and parent workshops. Demonstrate awareness and sensitivity to cultural perspectives on mental health and wellbeing within the Saudi Arabian context. Undertake risk assessments and risk management from a child psychotherapy perspective. Receive regular clinical professional supervision from a senior child psychotherapist. Support the wellbeing and mental health of Misk employees within the schools. Stay current with developments in theory and research, undertaking continuous professional development (CPD). Safeguarding Responsibilities The successful candidate will be responsible for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people, adhering to the school’s safeguarding policies and staff code of conduct. This role directly supports the Designated Safeguarding Lead to ensure the safety and wellbeing of all students. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in counselling or psychotherapy. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with students, parents, and other professionals. Commitment to ongoing professional development. Application Process Misk Schools offers a professional environment for dedicated individuals. Salary details for this full-time position will be discussed during the interview process.

e03fb98cc86fa623.description: About the Role WSP in the Middle East is seeking a Traffic Inspector (Road Safety) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring efficient traffic flow and road user safety on construction projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for conducting traffic inspections, implementing traffic management plans, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards. Key Responsibilities Conduct regular inspections of traffic management measures, signage, markings, and signals on road construction projects to ensure compliance with approved plans, specifications, and regulatory requirements. Review traffic management plans, temporary traffic diversions, and work zone layouts to identify potential risks, hazards, and congestion points, and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Monitor traffic flow and patterns near construction sites, assessing the impact of construction activities on road users, pedestrians, and neighboring communities. Collaborate with project stakeholders, including contractors, engineers, local authorities, and law enforcement agencies, to coordinate traffic management strategies and minimize disruptions. Implement traffic control measures, such as lane closures, detours, and temporary traffic signals, in accordance with approved plans and safety protocols. Conduct traffic impact assessments and modeling to predict the effects of construction activities on traffic congestion, travel times, and safety, and propose strategies to mitigate adverse impacts. Investigate traffic incidents, accidents, and near misses, documenting findings, identifying contributing factors, and recommending preventive measures to enhance safety. Provide guidance and training to construction teams and traffic control personnel on traffic management procedures, safety protocols, and regulatory compliance requirements. Stay abreast of industry developments, emerging technologies, and best practices in traffic management and transportation planning, incorporating relevant advancements into project strategies and methodologies. Uphold WSP's commitment to safety, sustainability, and quality excellence in all aspects of project execution. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in traffic inspection and road safety within construction projects. Work Environment and Culture WSP fosters a friendly and inclusive culture that values diverse backgrounds and experiences. The company is committed to safety, sustainability, and quality excellence, and encourages applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, disability, age, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, or maternity/paternity. All disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria will be interviewed. Benefits WSP offers competitive pay, first-class medical cover, and paid professional subscriptions. The global team comprises over 69,000 employees working to make a positive impact in communities worldwide. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

e0e68c52b583cfc0.description: Role Summary The Facility Engineer at HanmiGlobal Saudi will be responsible for managing and maintaining the operational efficiency of all facility systems and infrastructure. This role requires expertise in building facilities management, preventive maintenance, and coordination with various stakeholders to ensure that facilities operate safely, reliably, and efficiently. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day operations and maintenance of facility systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection. Develop and implement preventive maintenance programs to ensure optimal performance and longevity of equipment. Conduct regular inspections and assessments to identify and resolve facility-related issues. Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, and internal teams to support facility upgrades, repairs, and renovations. Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations. Maintain detailed records of maintenance activities, inventory, and service reports. Support budgeting, procurement, and resource allocation for facility management. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum 12 years of experience in facility engineering or related field, preferably within construction or infrastructure sectors. Strong technical knowledge of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire safety. Experience with preventive maintenance planning and facility management software. Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management, or related discipline. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams and manage multiple priorities. Familiarity with relevant regulations and standards in Saudi Arabia is an advantage.

e04454f52271bc0d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جاش للخدمات الفنيه عن مدير جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف المباشر على أنشطة إدارة وتخطيط الأعمال المتعلقة بالجودة، بما يضمن توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية للشركة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الجودة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والسياسات والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية والبرامج المتعلقة بإدارة الجودة. ضمان توافر كافة الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بأكبر كفاءة وفعالية ممكنة. المشاركة في وضع الأهداف والمبادرات والخطط التشغيلية التي تضمن وجود معايير الجودة والكفاءة العالية، ومتابعة تنفيذها. وضع وتطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التفصيلية التي تهدف إلى رفع جودة المخرجات والخدمات، ومتابعة تنفيذها. مراجعة وتطوير أنظمة ومعايير وإجراءات ونماذج ضبط وتوكيد الجودة، وإدارة عملية نشرها وتعميمها ومتابعة تنفيذها من خلال عمليات التدقيق. متابعة أحدث المستجدات والتطورات في أنظمة الجودة ووسائل توكيد المطابقة، وتقديم المقترحات لتحديث الأنظمة المعتمدة. الإشراف على إعداد الملخصات والتقارير العامة المتعلقة بأعمال توكيد ومعايير الجودة، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة الجودة. القدرة على وضع وتطوير الخطط التشغيلية والبرامج المتعلقة بالجودة. معرفة قوية بأنظمة ومعايير وإجراءات ضبط وتوكيد الجودة. القدرة على متابعة المستجدات والتطورات في مجال الجودة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل مدير الجودة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان تطبيق أعلى معايير الجودة في جميع عمليات الشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

e06c2fbf22027aea.description: About Assystem Assystem is dedicated to accelerating the global energy transition, with 7,000 professionals combining engineering expertise, project management, and digital technologies to address climate change. The company operates in 12 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, focusing on low-carbon electricity production and distribution through nuclear and renewable energies. Assystem also supports the modernization of energy grids, manages new transmission and distribution network setups, and utilizes hydrogen for decarbonizing transport and industry sectors. In Türkiye, Assystem works with both public and private sectors, specializing in ESIA studies, site investigations, and laboratory research. The company provides critical site supervision and engineering services for owners and lenders, contributing to major projects such as power generation and the construction of the Akkuyu nuclear power plant. The Senior Developer Role Assystem is seeking a Senior Developer to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh. This full-time position involves leading application development, customizations, and platform extensions in alignment with approved requirements and architectural standards. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience in relevant fields. Key Responsibilities Lead approved application development, customizations, and platform extensions according to specified requirements and architecture. Conduct code reviews, enforce secure coding practices, and ensure adherence to development standards. Develop and execute automated testing and unit testing, and support performance, regression, and security testing activities. Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex defects and Level 3 (L3) production incidents. Prepare release packages and support deployment, rollback, and hypercare activities. Maintain source code repositories, version control, and change management records. Provide evidence of testing, code quality, deployment validation, and production defect resolution. Conduct production issue analysis, root cause investigations, and implement corrective actions. Document maintainable solutions, technical designs, configurations, and support procedures. Support continuous improvement of application performance, reliability, security, and maintainability. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in development roles. Demonstrated experience with relevant tools and technologies. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, contributing to Assystem's mission in the energy transition sector.

e0ef0a21bcf10fc4.description: About the Role Saudi Air Navigation Services is seeking a Knowledge & Insights Researcher to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is designed for professionals with 0-1 year of experience, focusing on market insights and R&D initiatives within air navigation systems technology. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to gather, analyze, and disseminate critical market insights. This includes information on air navigation systems technology, competitor intelligence, and broader industry trends, all aimed at enhancing R&D initiatives. The role also involves managing a centralized knowledge platform to ensure relevant data is accessible to stakeholders and supporting innovation by identifying opportunities and addressing gaps. Key Responsibilities Gather and analyze market insights related to air navigation systems technology. Collect and disseminate competitor intelligence to inform strategic decisions. Monitor and report on industry trends to support R&D initiatives. Manage a centralized knowledge platform to ensure data accessibility for stakeholders. Identify innovation opportunities and address existing gaps within R&D. Drive continuous improvement in alignment with set KPIs, agreed budgets, and adopted policies and procedures. Experience Required 0-1 year of relevant professional experience. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia. e00d4343ee594997.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking a Project Manager to join their team in Al Qassim, Al Qasim, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for an experienced professional responsible for overseeing the successful execution of projects from planning through implementation. The role requires a strong focus on project delivery, stakeholder coordination, and adherence to quality and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Manage the development and implementation of project plans, schedules, budgets, and objectives. Monitor and control project progress and performance, ensuring timely delivery within scope and budget. Coordinate internal resources and external third parties/vendors for flawless project execution. Develop project scopes and objectives, involving all relevant stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility. Analyze project risks and develop mitigation strategies, ensuring resource availability and allocation. Use appropriate verification techniques to manage changes in project scope, schedule, and costs. Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools, and techniques, reporting and escalating to management as needed. Manage changes to the project scope, schedule, and costs. Ensure compliance with project safety and quality standards. Identify and resolve project issues, and create and maintain comprehensive project documentation. Provide technical guidance and support to team members. Continuous compliance with these requirements is essential throughout employment with Hill International. The role also involves performing other duties as assigned by the line manager or supervisor. Required Experience Candidates for this Project Manager position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in project management. e0b38dc5eb18ac5f.description: About the Role IDOM Consulting, Engineering, Architecture is seeking a Senior Telecommunications Engineer to join its Railway Systems team. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves significant contributions to a Metro Project. The selected candidate will focus on the design, coordination, and supervision of telecommunications and ICT systems, working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Role Context and Focus The Senior Telecommunications Engineer will be instrumental in delivering high-quality telecom solutions for a major infrastructure project. This position requires collaboration with Civil and Railway systems teams to ensure technical alignment and consistency across all project deliverables. While the primary location is Riyadh, the role may involve approximately 25% travel to Saudi Arabia if based in Spain. Key Responsibilities Delivering designs up to the 100% Detailed Design stage. Designing IP Telephony and Intercom systems for railway and critical environments, with additional experience in at least two of the following subsystems: Access Control Systems (ACS), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and CCTV cameras. Applying associated competencies for end-to-end subsystems, including IP networking, Cabling and Optical fiber networks, and ELV/Low voltage designs. Designing technical interfaces with multidisciplinary teams, including other Telecoms, SCADA, Civil works, MEP, and Systems Integration. Ensuring technical alignment and consistency across all telecom-related project deliverables. Preparing, reviewing, and validating design documents, drawings, specifications, Bills of Quantities (BoQs), and engineering reports. Participating in and leading technical coordination meetings with internal teams, contractors, and clients. Ensuring compliance with international railway and telecom standards and project requirements. Identifying risks related to telecom design, integration, or schedule, and proposing corrective actions. Qualifications and Experience A university degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Proven experience (5-10 years) in the detailed design of IP Telephony and Intercom, Access Control Systems, Intrusion Detection Systems, and CCTV systems is required. At least 7 years of experience in the design of telecommunications projects within large-scale infrastructure or transportation environments. Experience in the use of AutoCAD for engineering design is highly desirable. Knowledge of railway and transit communications environments is an advantage. Valuable experience in OT Cybersecurity (EN 62443). Required Skills Strong communication skills, with the ability to interact directly with end customers and coordinate with multidisciplinary teams. A high degree of autonomy, strong analytical skills, and an innovative mindset. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic team focused on significant railway infrastructure projects. The role requires close collaboration with various engineering disciplines to achieve project objectives.

e0e26637d31ae8db.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة مها الفلا للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على متابعة الطلبات، ضمان دقة التسليم، والتواصل الفعال مع العملاء والمتاجر. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، ويوفر فرصة للمساهمة في عمليات التسليم اليومية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة الطلبات الواردة عبر تطبيق المندوب وقبول الطلبات المناسبة وفقًا لآلية العمل المعتمدة. التحقق من تفاصيل الطلب، بما في ذلك موقع الاستلام والتسليم، قبل بدء عملية التوصيل. استلام الطلبات من المتاجر، مطابقتها مع بيانات الطلب، وضمان سلامتها أثناء النقل. التواصل بوضوح مع العملاء والمتاجر عند الضرورة، وإبلاغهم بأي تأخير أو مشكلات قد تطرأ. تسليم الطلبات للعملاء وتحديث حالتها في التطبيق فور إتمام عملية التوصيل. الالتزام بقواعد المرور والمحافظة على نظافة المركبة وجاهزيتها للعمل. التعامل مع المبالغ والمدفوعات وفقًا للإجراءات المعتمدة، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات مالية. رفع المشكلات والشكاوى إلى المشرف المباشر ومتابعتها حتى يتم حلها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو التوصيل. القدرة على استخدام تطبيقات الهواتف الذكية لتتبع الطلبات وتحديث الحالات. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات المحددة للعمل. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة وواضحة. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء والمتاجر بمهنية. الالتزام بالمواعيد والدقة في إنجاز المهام. القدرة على حل المشكلات الأساسية التي قد تواجه عملية التوصيل. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ويتطلب الدور التنقل المستمر لتلبية متطلبات التوصيل. يتم العمل ضمن فريق يدعم تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية للمؤسسة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى مؤسسة مها الفلا للتجارة.

e011ced116b93a1c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية لمختلف التطبيقات المنزلية والصناعية والتجارية، وفهم مكوناتها بدقة. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المطلوبة، وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات مع مطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، بما في ذلك تشغيل دارات التمديدات وفحصها، وإجراء فحوصات العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، ومتابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأجهزة التمديدات الكهربائية ومواصفاتها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ويوفر فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

e07670bc9d1e47fb.description: About the Role Saudi Consulting Services (Saudconsult) is seeking an experienced Structural CAD Draftsman to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves preparing accurate structural and shop drawings for various construction projects, working closely with structural engineers to translate designs into detailed technical drawings. Your work will encompass the full lifecycle of drawing preparation, from initial drafting to as-built documentation and revisions based on feedback from project stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Prepare structural and shop drawings for buildings and construction projects using AutoCAD. Draft foundation, column, beam, slab, and concrete wall drawings. Prepare rebar detailing and bar bending schedules. Prepare steel structure drawings and connection details as required. Coordinate structural drawings with architectural and MEP drawings to identify and resolve clashes. Convert hand sketches and preliminary designs into accurate digital drawings. Prepare As-Built drawings based on site data. Revise and update drawings based on feedback from engineers, consultants, and clients. Extract preliminary concrete and steel quantities as required. Ensure compliance with approved codes and standards, including the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and government authority requirements. Organize and archive drawings and files in accordance with the document control system. Proficiency in AutoCAD. Ability to read structural and architectural drawings and technical specifications. Basic knowledge of rebar and reinforced concrete detailing. e016c42b6f01b57e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خالد صالح الحسين للمقاولات عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الحدود الشمالية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة وفقًا للمسارات وخطط العمل المحددة، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد السلامة المرورية والتشغيلية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة والالتزام بالمسارات المحددة وفقًا لخطط العمل المتبعة. الالتزام التام بقواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، والتنبه لعدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية على الشاحنة ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ عليها. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة التي تتطلب فحص الخبراء عند ملاحظة أي خلل فني. الالتزام الكامل بأدلة الإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو ما يعادلها. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة على الطرق. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة وتحديد الأعطال البسيطة. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات التشغيلية. نوع الوظيفة وموقع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في منطقة الحدود الشمالية. يتطلب الدور حضورًا منتظمًا للقيام بالمهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

e05472040e5b9da2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابرار الطائف التجارية عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير السياسات للسلع والخدمات، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على تنفيذها وتقييمها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد الأهداف التسويقية العامة والفرعية، وتطوير السياسات والخطط والبرامج التسويقية. تحليل دورة حياة المنتج وتحديد أسباب نجاح أو فشل تسويق المنتجات. تحليل أسعار المنافسين وتطوير سياسات تسعير تنافسية. تحديد برامج الترويج، واختيار قنوات التوزيع المناسبة، وتقييم فعالية الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية. وضع برنامج زمني لتنفيذ السياسات التسويقية، ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ، وتقييم النتائج المحققة. إجراء اختبارات للسوق للمنتجات الجديدة قبل طرحها بشكل نهائي، باستخدام برامج حاسوبية متخصصة وفقاً لمتطلبات العمل. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتسويق، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التسويق. القدرة على تحديد الأهداف التسويقية وتطوير الاستراتيجيات. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتقييم أداء المنتجات والسوق. إتقان إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل سيعمل أخصائي التسويق ضمن فريق شركة ابرار الطائف التجارية في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. المدينة: الطائف. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه.

e060f62f8cf1cce0.description: Job description Consultant - Cybersecurity, Penetration Testing Date: 22 Oct 2026 Custom Field 1: 733155 Location: Riyadh, SA #job-location.job-location-inline { display: inline; } Facility: Technology & Engineering Job Description OVERVIEW Job Title Consultant Job Code 733155 Grade I3 Group Legal, Risk & Governance Division Technology Department Cybersecurity Unit PT&VA ROLE PURPOSE The aim is to state the overall significance of the job from the organization’s perspective. The role exists to support the identification and assessment of cybersecurity weaknesses through the planning and execution of authorized penetration testing engagements across applications, infrastructure, and other agreed technology environments. The role provides technical analysis and practical remediation recommendations, validates corrective actions, and contributes to the continuous improvement of penetration testing practices to strengthen the organization’s cybersecurity posture. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & ACTIVITIES This section describes the principal outputs required from the job. Key Accountabilities Key Activities Engagement Scoping & Planning Define testing objectives, scope, prerequisites, and deliverables with asset owners and relevant cybersecurity stakeholders. Prepare engagement plans and rules of engagement covering authorization, permitted techniques, testing windows, and escalation arrangements. Assess testing risks and coordinate access and operational safeguards before commencing approved activities. Application & API Penetration Testing Perform authorized penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, and APIs within the agreed scope. Assess authentication, authorization, session management, input handling, and business logic controls using manual and automated techniques. Validate identified weaknesses and document reproducible evidence and potential business impacts. Infrastructure & Platform Penetration Testing Assess in-scope internal and external networks, systems, and cloud environments for exploitable weaknesses and configuration gaps. Evaluate attack paths, privilege boundaries, and exposure of sensitive services through controlled testing within approved limits. e0fb8040825734cc.job_title: Butcher-Six Senses Southern Dunes, The Red Sea (Local Talent)
e0fb8040825734cc.description: As Butcher, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses Southern Dunes, The Red Sea to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness. Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and ensure full knowledge and active participation in all our brand initiatives. Select, inspect, trim, cut and debone meat, poultry and seafood according to established specifications. Ensure proper portion control, product quality and minimal waste. Maintain accurate inventories and ensure correct storage, labelling and temperature control. Follow production schedules and coordinate with Stores and the Financial Controller to ensure product availability. Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, fire and workplace safety requirements. Maintain all equipment in good working condition and ensure proper personal grooming and hygiene. Support kitchen operations when required and attend meetings and training sessions. Protect guest, colleague and residential owner privacy and confidential information. Promote property facilities and activities when appropriate. Strictly adhere to Six Senses and LQA standards. Perform any additional duties assigned by the supervisor or management. Understanding of HACCP principles, inventory control and waste management. Fluent in Arabic; I understand that English language is preferred. You’re about to be the author of this journey that takes you through life’s undiscovered passageways, hidden treasures, and meaningful experiences. It’s a story unlike any other. e0e744ac3430d2fa.description: OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE We are driven to create a future where people and place enrich one another. We are wholly committed to rooting ourselves more deeply in every place we are in while setting new benchmarks for positive impact. As a pioneering collective with a common purpose, we curate extraordinary moments and honor the soul of every place along our journey. At Rosewood Hotel Group, we answer The Calling. Together, we Make the Place. THE TEAM As part of the Butler team, you will support the delivery of exceptional and highly personalised guest experiences across the resort. Reporting directly to the Chief Butler and working closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Culinary, Engineering, Transportation and Concierge teams, you will help ensure seamless service delivery and operational excellence for every guest stay. Working alongside the Chief Butler, you will help guide, motivate and develop the Butler team while ensuring the consistent delivery of Rosewood and luxury hospitality service standards. This role combines guest experience leadership, operational oversight and team development. You will be instrumental in creating memorable, tailored experiences for guests while driving service excellence, maintaining operational efficiency and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement. Oversee guest profiles, operational reports, service documentation and departmental communications to maintain accuracy and consistency. Collaborate closely with operational departments to ensure flawless execution of guest requests, special occasions, VIP stays and bespoke experiences. Monitor service quality through inspections, audits and guest feedback, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives when required. COULD THIS BE YOU? You bring substantial experience in a luxury hospitality supervisory or Butler leadership environment, with a strong track record of delivering exceptional guest service. You are a confident leader who can motivate, coach and develop teams while maintaining a positive and professional working environment. You are comfortable using hospitality systems and technology platforms to manage guest preferences, operational information and service delivery. This includes medical coverage, complimentary room nights, learning and development opportunities, and global career opportunities across Rosewood Hotel Group. Associates are also entitled to benefits and leave provisions in accordance with applicable Saudi Arabian labour laws and company policies. OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU At Rosewood Hotel Group, your voice is heard – and valued. We’re a community that encourages associates to be themselves, not fit into a fixed culture, and this philosophy shines through in our commitments to reflect and honor the history, culture and geography of our destinations. We’re not only committed to building and nurturing genuine, long-lasting relationships but to transforming them – and our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) strategy helps put these principles into practice.

e05e1bf64a1b7af8.description: Job description About the job E&I ENGINEER (CS) We are seeking an experienced E&I Engineer (Construction Support – CS) with 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing electrical and instrumentation engineering support to shipyard production teams, resolving construction and installation-related technical issues, reviewing and updating production drawings, and ensuring the accuracy, constructability, and compliance of E&I systems with project specifications and applicable marine standards. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Provide construction and production support for Electrical and Instrumentation (E&I) installation activities in marine, shipbuilding, and offshore vessel projects. Review, prepare, and revise E&I engineering deliverables, including: Electrical equipment layout and installation drawings Cable routing, cable tray, and cable ladder layouts Cable schedules, termination diagrams, and interconnection drawings Lighting, power distribution, and small power layouts Instrument location and installation drawings Instrument hook-up drawings and installation details Junction box layouts and cable termination details Earthing and bonding layouts Equipment mounting, supports, and installation arrangements 2D production drawings and 3D models for E&I systems Review shop drawings, installation drawings, and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams during electrical equipment installation, cable pulling, cable termination, instrument mounting, and system integration activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), site and production issues, drawing discrepancies, and installation-related engineering problems. Incorporate engineering changes, production feedback, and redline mark-ups into drawings, cable schedules, and 3D models. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper E&I integration and avoid clashes. Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, cable requirements, and technical documentation to ensure compatibility with vessel arrangements and installation requirements. Verify cable routing, equipment accessibility, installation clearances, maintenance access, and interface requirements before execution. Support constructability reviews and identify potential installation constraints, routing conflicts, and design discrepancies. Ensure E&I installation arrangements comply with project specifications, applicable marine standards, classification society requirements, and shipyard construction procedures. Coordinate with electrical and instrumentation engineers, designers, equipment vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of technical issues. Support the preparation and updating of cable schedules, equipment lists, material lists, and installation documentation, where required. Assist in resolving issues related to equipment positioning, cable tray routing, penetrations, supports, and interfaces with structural and mechanical systems. Maintain updated production drawings, technical records, and construction documentation in accordance with project procedures. Support as-built drawing updates and incorporate final production modifications, where required. Ensure construction support deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in E&I engineering or construction support within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Hands-on experience in Construction Support (CS), shipyard production support, and E&I drawing modifications. Strong experience in electrical and instrumentation installation layouts, cable routing, equipment positioning, and associated engineering activities. Good understanding of marine electrical systems, power distribution, lighting, earthing, cable management, instrumentation installation, and control system interfaces. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, cable schedules, installation drawings, and 3D models. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software accepted by the client. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, electrical schematics, instrument hook-up drawings, cable schedules, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during construction and installation activities. Familiarity with marine classification society requirements, applicable IEC standards, shipbuilding standards, and project specifications. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines. Understanding of cable routing through bulkheads and decks, equipment mounting arrangements, penetrations, and associated installation interfaces. Experience in new-build shipbuilding projects, offshore vessels, FPSOs, or similar marine engineering projects is preferred. Exposure to international shipyards, marine EPC contractors, or multidisciplinary engineering environments is preferred. Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment. VERTICAL ENGINEERING Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

e0c1ec8f055d7fbb.job_title: Director of Security – Four Seasons Hotel Madinah, Saudi Arabia
e0c1ec8f055d7fbb.description: Job description About Four Seasons: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us. About the location: Steps from the Prophet’s Mosque, our Hotel will offer luxury accommodation for the city’s 1.5 million annual visitors. The new-build hotel will be located at the heart of Madinah and steps from one of the most historic and significant sites in the region: Al-Masjid an-Nabawi, also known as the Prophet’s Mosque. Madinah is also home to the Quba Mosque, which is regarded as the oldest mosque in the world. About the Role We are seeking an experienced and proactive Director of Security to oversee the safety and security operations at Four Seasons Hotel Madinah. Reporting to the Director of Operations , you will be responsible for ensuring a secure environment for guests, employees, and hotel assets. You will lead the security team, implement security protocols, and oversee emergency response procedures while maintaining the highest standards of service and professionalism. What You Will Do Oversee the daily operations of the security department, ensuring the safety and security of the hotel’s guests, staff, and property. Lead, train, and manage the security team, ensuring effective performance and adherence to hotel security policies and procedures. Develop, implement, and regularly update security protocols, emergency procedures, and risk management strategies. Conduct regular security audits and inspections to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with safety regulations. Respond to emergency situations such as fire alarms, medical incidents, or security breaches, ensuring quick resolution and safety. Manage the surveillance systems and review footage to investigate and report incidents. Ensure security policies are followed during hotel events, meetings, and guest activities. Collaborate with other hotel departments to ensure seamless operations, especially during large events or high-risk situations. Monitor and assess the security of hotel access points, parking areas, and public spaces. Prepare reports on security-related incidents, daily activities, and department performance metrics. Manage the department’s budget, ensuring the efficient use of resources, staffing, and equipment. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Security Management , Criminal Justice, or a related field. Proven experience in security management, with previous experience in a supervisory role, preferably within the hospitality industry. Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills . In-depth knowledge of security protocols, emergency response procedures, and regulatory compliance. Ability to work under pressure and make quick, effective decisions in crisis situations. Familiarity with security systems, surveillance tools, and incident reporting software. Proficiency in English. What We Offer Competitive salary in a tax-free environment. Housing and transportation allowances. 30 days of vacation plus public holidays. Complimentary meals and uniform cleaning. Medical and life insurance. Employee Assistance Program and worldwide complimentary room nights. Opportunities for growth and development. Additional family benefits. Schedule & Hours This is a full-time role. Localization As part of our commitment to Saudization, we actively welcome applications from Saudi nationals. Join us in shaping the future of luxury hospitality in Madinah. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

e04478670ef5f8b2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في وادي الدواسر. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة، بالإضافة إلى تطوير إجراءات العمل وتقييم الأداء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتضمن هذا الدور مجموعة من المهام المحورية لضمان سير عمل الخدمات العامة بكفاءة وفعالية. تشمل المسؤوليات الرئيسية ما يلي: مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال ونشاطات موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل وأولوياته وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات العلاقة لضمان التكامل. دراسة مشكلات العمل وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الخدمات العامة أو إدارة العمليات ذات الصلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل يعمل مراقب الخدمات العامة في شركة اغادير نجد للمقاولات ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في الرياض، وتحديداً في وادي الدواسر. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام والمسؤوليات المحددة. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: الرياض. المدينة: وادي الدواسر. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن.

e0c593f013930119.job_title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Service Suite
e0c593f013930119.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why this role matters Customer service is evolving faster than ever. Customers expect instant, personalized support, while support teams are under constant pressure to resolve issues faster without sacrificing quality. AI is fundamentally changing how support organizations operate, and we're building the products that will define that future. As our Principal Product Manager , you'll own the strategy and direction of Lucidya's Customer Service Suite , including OmniServ, our ticketing and case management platform, mobile experience, and the AI-powered capabilities that enable support teams to work smarter. This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a backlog. You'll define where the product goes, make difficult prioritization decisions, and shape experiences that thousands of users rely on every day. You'll spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, and turn those insights into products that solve meaningful problems. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, questions assumptions, and is excited by building products where AI creates real customer value - not simply because it's the latest trend. What You'll Do Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Lucidya's Customer Service Suite, ensuring every investment moves the product closer to solving meaningful customer problems. Spend time with customer support teams, operations leaders, and enterprise customers to deeply understand how they work, where they struggle, and what would genuinely improve their day-to-day experience. Work closely with Engineering and Design to continuously deliver valuable improvements, favouring learning through iteration over waiting for perfection. Make thoughtful product decisions by balancing customer needs, business priorities, technical complexity, and long-term platform strategy. Champion AI-powered experiences that genuinely improve agent productivity and customer outcomes, rather than adding technology for technology's sake. Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing to ensure new capabilities are successfully adopted and create measurable business impact after launch. Use customer feedback, product analytics, market trends, and experimentation to continuously improve the product and validate product decisions. Create alignment across stakeholders by communicating product strategy, priorities, trade-offs, and roadmap decisions with clarity and confidence. Build trust across cross-functional teams by creating a collaborative environment where great ideas can come from anyone. Who You Are You've spent 7-9 years building B2B SaaS products and have owned a product or product suite end-to-end—not just individual features. You enjoy solving customer problems more than shipping features. You naturally ask "What problem are we solving?" before deciding "What should we build?" You're comfortable making difficult prioritization decisions and explaining the reasoning behind them, even when not everyone agrees. You enjoy spending time with customers and believe the best product decisions come from understanding real user behaviour rather than assumptions. You collaborate exceptionally well with engineers and designers. You don't need to write production code, but you're technical enough to challenge ideas, understand trade-offs, and make informed decisions together. You're naturally curious. Whether it's a new AI capability, workflow automation tool, or emerging technology, you've probably already experimented with it before someone asked you to. You value progress over perfection and know when it's time to ship, learn, and iterate. You're comfortable using data to support your decisions but know that numbers alone rarely tell the full story. You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences alike and can simplify complex ideas without oversimplifying the problem. You'll likely have experience with Product management platforms such as Jira and Confluence. Collaboration tools including Miro and Figma. Product analytics platforms such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar. SQL for exploring product data and validating hypotheses. Customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, or similar. Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent productivity tools. Bonus points if you have: Previously worked in Customer Support, Customer Success, Contact Centres, or Service Operations before moving into Product. Built AI-powered workflows or automation products that delivered measurable customer outcomes. Experience designing or building enterprise customer service software. What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months) Within your first six months, you'll have built a deep understanding of Lucidya's Customer Service Suite, our customers, and the workflows that power their support operations. More importantly, you'll have: Become the go-to product leader for the Customer Service Suite, with a deep understanding of both the product and the customer problems it solves. Shipped meaningful improvements to OmniServ or the mobile experience that customers notice and that measurably improve how support teams work. Earned the trust of Engineering, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders by making thoughtful product decisions, communicating trade-offs clearly, and consistently delivering value. Built strong relationships with customers and established a regular feedback loop that directly influences product priorities. Defined and communicated a clear product roadmap that balances customer needs, business priorities, and long-term product strategy. Identified opportunities to leverage AI and automation in ways that create genuine value for support teams rather than simply introducing new technology. What the hiring process will look like Our hiring process is designed to help both you and us determine whether this is the right fit. The process typically includes: An introductory conversation with Talent Acquisition. A Product Leadership interview to explore your product thinking, leadership style, and experience. A case study where you'll demonstrate how you approach solving complex product challenges and communicate your decisions. A presentation/panel interview to showcase your findings A final conversation with executive leadership / Offer discussion. Throughout the process, we're looking beyond experience alone. We want to understand how you think, how you make decisions, how you collaborate with others, and how you approach building products that customers genuinely love.
